_about: Camera block: dashcam (behind the windscreen of the dark grey hatchback, which waits at the east stop line then drives forward; 100 degree lens).
temporal_caption: At 0:00 a dashcam looks straight ahead through the windscreen of a car stopped at a red light, with a strip of its dark hood at the bottom of the frame. Just ahead is a zebra crosswalk: the pedestrian in the white shirt crosses from the left and the pedestrian in the red jacket from the right. Across the intersection a traffic light shows red and the blue sedan waits facing the camera. From 0:01 to 0:04 the white SUV crosses in front from left to right and the red sedan crosses from right to left. At 0:03 the side lights turn amber, then red. At about 0:04 the light ahead turns green and the pedestrians reach the sidewalks. From 0:05 to 0:07 the car drives slowly forward into the intersection and the blue sedan passes on the left.

aesthetics.composition: Forward view down the street; buildings on both sides, the intersection in the middle

cinematography.camera_motion: Static while the car waits, then moving slowly forward from about 0:05
cinematography.framing: Wide forward view through the windscreen
cinematography.camera_angle: Eye level from inside a car

segments.description: One continuous dashcam shot from the waiting car
segments.key_changes: Cars cross in front; the light ahead turns green; the car moves forward
segments.camera: Dashcam fixed to the car, moves with it
